seo.title: How RAVU Works — Step-by-Step Guide
seo.description: A clear route into a connected mobility ecosystem for members and organisations.

hero.title: A simple path into a
hero.text: RAVU brings members, riders, partners and community together through one clear journey — discover, join, connect and grow.

features.title: 1. Join via the app
features.text: Riders and drivers register directly in the RAVU mobile app.

features.title: 2. Get verified ID
features.text: Receive your digital RAVU Member ID for instant recognition.

features.title: 3. Unlock partner value
features.text: Access discounts, workshops and services across the network.

steps.title: Discover. Join.
steps.text: Six clear steps, each building on the last.

items.title: Discover RAVU
items.text: Understand the membership ecosystem and how riders, drivers and partners connect.

items.title: Register
items.text: Sign up in the mobile app or share your interest online to join the network.

items.title: Become a member
items.text: Complete verification and activate your digital RAVU Member ID.

items.title: Access the ecosystem
items.text: Explore partner fuel stations, repair workshops and financial services.

items.title: Participate
items.text: Build connections through local mobility hubs and community initiatives.

items.title: Grow with RAVU
items.text: Move forward with lower operating costs and a stronger support network.

cards.title: Members at the Centre
cards.text: RAVU starts with people and connects the services around them. Every part of the ecosystem exists to serve the rider, driver and commuter at the centre of it.

cards.title: Partners in the Ecosystem
cards.text: Partners contribute relevant support, maintenance discounts, fuel offers and financial opportunities — making membership genuinely valuable every single day.
